unverified: All ENGR 201 W22 PDFs (syllabus, 18 lecture slide decks, 9 homeworks, 9 solutions) return HTTP 404 and have no Wayback captures, so homework problem counts and topics are inferred from the lecture schedule only.
W22 grading breakdown, exam rules (calculator? notes sheet?) and exam durations are unknown because the syllabus PDF is gone.
No W22 quizzes, midterms or finals were ever posted publicly. No OSU ENGR 201/ECE 201 past exams with solutions were found anywhere on official OSU pages.
No public course site, syllabus or slides exist for ECE 201 under Najim, Boeding (Fall 2026) or Tingwei Zhang (Winter 2027). EECS class list shows no web link. Syllabus is Canvas-only per Ecampus.

Ulaby section numbers in week_map come from the UMich EECS 215 FA20 reading schedule (2nd-ed era) plus chapter titles verified on Fulcrum. They may shift slightly in the 3rd edition (2025). Mesh section 3-3/3-4 was not listed there and is a guess. Confirm against the PDF bookmarks once downloaded.
Ulaby CAD 3e license: listed as Open Access; no Creative Commons license was seen. The PDF requires submitting a Google Form (course number and university), so Connor should do this himself.
Where ECE 201 places its new semiconductor devices/fabrication unit, and what the labs cover, is unknown.

Mapping W22 ENGR 201 (3 cr, no lab, 2x50 min/week) onto ECE 201 (4 cr, 2x80 min lecture + 2 h lab/week) is an assumption. ECE 201 likely spends more time on first-order transients and adds semiconductors.
The errata PDF on the companion site is for an older 'Circuits, 3rd Edition (NTS, 2016)' and probably does not apply to CAD 3e.
The equations PDF is from the 2013 'Circuits' edition; chapters 1-5 match CAD in content, but equation numbers may differ.
